rationale: TF-0494 requires a single user-level Workspace Context profile with default-on behavior. The preliminary paths cover raw DCS controls and runtime context but not the Electron defaults, typed host API, user Settings surface, or i18n needed to remove per-flag user management. This proposal records the exact additional authority paths only; it does not change node status or activate another node.
